snippet.title: Skatelander - Endless Arcade Skateboarding
snippet.description:
Get it on Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.underdogsthestudio.Skatelander
Get it on iOs: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/skatelander-endless-arcade/id970368198?mt=8
Nominated "Best Game Art" at Casual Connect Asia 2015
"Skatelander is a simple endless runner but it scratches that 'one more go' itch" - 4/5 by 148Apps.com

"The gameplay is actually solid, like it's totally strong" - Appspy

"Skateboarding is not a crime, and with all the money laying around in the world of Skatelander, it pays, too" - Toucharcade

Features stunning voxel art style with around 60 different characters and beautiful environments. Lots of crazy stunts and skateboards to set your wheels rolling. Show off your style of play by sharing videos with your friends.

- Stunning Voxel Art
- 60 entertaining characters
- Different environments based on the characters
- Crazy Stunts and hilarious characters' antics
- Around 25 unique skateboards
- Share "How awesome you played" video with friends
- Funny Sounds
